annotations.title: Which topics on this subject are getting views on YouTube?

description: Use when the user is a creator, creator manager or brand team planning content on a subject and asks which angle gets watched: "which GTA 6 topics are pulling views right now?", "do trailer videos beat leak videos?", "who owns the views on this?". Returns YouTube's most-viewed videos on the subject from the window, split by the title topics you name: videos, median views and median views per day for each, Shorts against long-form, the top channels' share of views and the top 10 videos. Public counts only; results cannot be published. Refuses before you are charged if the search drifts off the subject. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one window of days; re-run for a later window; segment: topics; Shorts against long-form. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To compare named channels rather than topics, use run_channel_benchmark; for what viewers say under one video, use run_comment_themes.
